edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending address.
approve sets allowance for _msgSender().
Allowance is consumed against the caller-derived spender.
Caller-controlled address becomes the 'from' argument of _transfer.
manualswap authorizes only msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes only msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1.
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner check comparing _owner to _msgSender().
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner.
liftMaxTx is restricted by onlyOwner.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Constructor seeds _rOwned[address(this)] with the full reflection supply.
Constructor initializes _rTotal from MAX modulo _tTotal.
Constructor whitelists owner, contract and fee wallet from fees.
Constructor assigns the fee wallet addresses.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance via _approve.
transferFrom reads the stored allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
balanceOf converts stored reflections via tokenFromReflection.
Reflection conversion divides by the current rate.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
require(!bots[from]) gates the transfer on a blacklist lookup.
Cooldown branch requires amount <= _maxTxAmount.
cooldownEnabled decides whether the max-tx check applies.
inSwap prevents nested automatic swaps.
swapEnabled decides whether auto-swap logic runs.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against the sender.
_transfer sets the reward fee rate.
_transfer sets the marketing/dev fee rate.
External swap happens mid-transfer before token balances are updated.
ETH distribution occurs before the token state update completes.
_transfer finalizes with _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
The stored router address is used for the swap and WETH lookup.
sendETHToFee makes three outbound ETH transfers.
First third of ETH is sent to fee wallet 1.
Second third of ETH is sent to fee wallet 2.
Third third of ETH is sent to fee wallet 3.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
Router address is set by the owner-only setup path.
Pair address is assigned during owner-only openTrading.
tradingOpen flag is flipped by the owner-only function.
swapEnabled is enabled in openTrading.
cooldownEnabled is enabled in openTrading.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to 650M tokens.
manualswap triggers an external swap on the whole contract balance.
manualsend distributes the full ETH balance to fee wallets.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard derives fee-inclusive amounts from _getValues.
Sender and recipient reflection balances are added/subtracted.
Team share is routed through _takeTeam.
Fee reflection is applied through _reflectFee.
_takeTeam multiplies the team amount by the current rate.
Team reflection share is credited to the contract balance.
_rTotal is reduced by the fee.
_tFeeTotal accumulates the token fee.
_getValues fetches the current rate.
Reflection supply feeds the value computation.
_getRate divides reflection supply by token supply.
_getRate reads _rTotal supply.
Owner-only toggle writes cooldownEnabled.
Owner-only function resets the maximum transaction amount.
owner() exposes the privileged _owner address.
renounceOwnership clears the privileged owner slot.
Sender parameter flows into the transfer body.
Recipient parameter flows into the transfer body.
Amount parameter drives the cooldown and transfer math.
Local contract token balance is read inside _transfer.
Captured contract balance is passed straight into swapTokensForEth.
Token amount parameter is used as swap input.
Swap path array is passed to the router.
ETH amount parameter is divided among the fee wallets.

Spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
Token amount parameter is decomposed into fee and transfer amounts.
